tables.name: public.picking_records
tables.comment: Individual harvest entries. Each record = one delivery of boxes/kg by a worker.

columns.name: quantity
columns.comment: Units harvested (boxes or kg). Must be > 0.

columns.name: rate_amount_snapshot
columns.comment: Rate frozen at time of recording for traceability.

columns.name: recorded_by
columns.comment: Supervisor who registered this entry.

columns.name: original_record_id
columns.comment: If this is a correction, points to the original record.

columns.name: organization_id
columns.comment: Tenant propietario. Debe coincidir con el de worker y block (FK compuesta).

columns.name: row_id
columns.comment: Melga (field_rows) opcional de donde salió la cosecha. NULL si el tenant/campo no usa melgas. Debe pertenecer al mismo block_id del registro.

columns.name: day_roster_id
columns.comment: Roster del día (day_roster) bajo el cual se registró la producción. Congela la atribución trabajador-responsable de esa jornada. NULL para registros sin roster.

columns.name: box_type_id
columns.comment: Tipo de caja usada (box_types). NULL si el tenant/producto no usa control de destare. Debe pertenecer al mismo tenant.

columns.name: gross_weight_kg
columns.comment: Peso bruto pesado en balanza (kg), incluye la tara. Snapshot inmutable de auditoría.

columns.name: tare_snapshot_kg
columns.comment: Tara aplicada al momento del registro (kg), congelada desde box_types.tare_weight_kg.

columns.name: net_weight_kg
columns.comment: Peso neto = bruto - tara (kg). Snapshot inmutable de auditoría. No altera el pago (que es por quantity).

columns.name: out_of_tolerance
columns.comment: true si el peso neto quedó fuera de la banda de tolerancia de la caja al registrar. Alerta de merma, no bloqueante.

columns.name: backup_image_path
columns.comment: Ruta (storage key) de la foto de respaldo en el bucket privado picking-evidence. NULL si no se adjuntó. Formato {org_id}/{record_id}/{uuid}.jpg. Se accede con URL firmada temporal; nunca es pública.

columns.name: payment_unit
columns.comment: Unidad de pago congelada al registrar (box|kg). box: pago por quantity; kg: pago por paid_quantity_kg.

columns.name: paid_quantity_kg
columns.comment: Kilos pagables (snapshot inmutable). Obligatorio y > 0 cuando payment_unit=kg; NULL cuando payment_unit=box.

indexes.name: picking_records_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX picking_records_pkey ON public.picking_records USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_picking_records_worker_day
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_picking_records_worker_day ON public.picking_records USING btree (worker_id, work_day)

indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_picking_records_day_roster ON public.picking_records USING btree (day_roster_id) WHERE (day_roster_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_picking_records_box_type_id
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_picking_records_box_type_id ON public.picking_records USING btree (box_type_id) WHERE (box_type_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_picking_records_out_of_tolerance ON public.picking_records USING btree (organization_id, work_day) WHERE out_of_tolerance

indexes.name: idx_picking_payment_unit
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX idx_picking_payment_unit ON public.picking_records USING btree (payment_unit)

constraints.name: chk_picking_paid_kg
constraints.def: CHECK ((((payment_unit = 'box'::unit_measure) AND (paid_quantity_kg IS NULL)) OR ((payment_unit = 'kg'::unit_measure) AND (paid_quantity_kg IS NOT NULL) AND (paid_quantity_kg > (0)::numeric))))

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (original_record_id) REFERENCES picking_records(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: picking_records_organization_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (block_id, organization_id) REFERENCES blocks(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.comment: Garantiza que el picking_record y su block pertenecen a la misma organización.

constraints.name: fk_picking_worker_org

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (day_roster_id, organization_id) REFERENCES day_roster(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.comment: Garantiza que el picking_record y su roster del día pertenecen a la misma organización.

constraints.name: fk_picking_box_type_org
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (box_type_id, organization_id) REFERENCES box_types(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.comment: Garantiza que el picking_record y su tipo de caja pertenecen a la misma organización.
